root_cause: The legacy Python SEO checker compared raw header/footer fragments against canonical template bytes while the modern production build and JS shell contract validate projected semantic shell state. Both oracles could disagree and create estate-wide false high-severity drift.
prevention_rule: Canonical shell truth has one authority: tools/controleer-site-ui.mjs verifyPageShell/verifyGlobalComponentHashes and its canonical shell workflows. SEO strategy checking must not independently reimplement shell equality.
